title: Fix orphaned-capability-goal_summary by adding activity and registering shape
description: Adds the 'summarize-goals' activity to invoke the 'goal_summary' resolver and registers the 'goal_summary' shape in discovery-registration.ts, thereby closing the orphaned-capability-goal_summary gap.

changes.anchor:
shapes: 'conceptDbReachable' in config && config.conceptDbReachable === false
      ? config.discovery.shapes.filter((s: string) => !['concept_usage_record', 'concept_search_by_source', 'concept_select_for_prompt'].includes(s))
      : config.discovery.shapes,
